name: Anker 332 USB-C Hub (5-in-1)
caption:
Add the ports your laptop forgot. 🔌

The Anker 332 USB-C hub adds 4K HDMI, a 5Gbps USB-C data port and two 5Gbps USB-A ports through a single USB-C connection.

Tip: check that your laptop's USB-C port supports video output before you rely on HDMI.
